decisions.reason: As a core garage-door-operator line with several models that strengthens the firm's one-stop residential offering, it remains worth retaining because its strategic value is high and its market role should now be clearer.

After several years, the uncertainty around this lightly differentiated operator variant should be largely resolved, and its strong overlap with the broader operator line makes withdrawal or absorption the more efficient choice.

This glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits the firm's compliance- and performance-oriented industrial portfolio well, so it is sensible to keep as a niche but credible option with limited incremental retention cost.
A dedicated glazed industrial sectional door remains a good strategic fit with the firm's industrial systems business, and its stronger standalone commitment supports continued retention.
